sources.title: Yume: An Interactive World Generation Model | alphaXiv
sources.snippet: Yume introduces an interactive world generation model that synthesizes dynamic, explorable virtual environments from images or text, featuring intuitive keyboard-driven camera control. The model produces high-fidelity real-world urban scenes, outperforming existing methods in visual quality and instruction following.

sources.title: Yume: An Interactive World Generation Model
sources.snippet: We can compensate for our real-world regrets or realize our wishes through the virtual world created by Yume. In this paper, we present a preview version of Yume, which is an interactive world generation model that allows the use of keyboard inputs to explore a dynamic world created by an input image.
